findings.reason: Canonical line 29 reads يحب كل من يراه ويميل إليه بطبعه, not يحبه كل من يراه. With the bearer as the continuing implicit subject, يحب كل من يراه says he loves everyone who sees him. The current text reverses the direction of love, apparently harmonizing it with the preceding محبوباً عند الناس; preserve the unusual literal clause.

findings.reason: Canonical line 29: يحب كل من يراه ويميل إليه بطبعه. The transmitted verb lacks the object suffix in يحبه; the continuing subject loves everyone who sees him, rather than everyone loving him. Do not normalize to the surrounding claim that he is beloved.
